description: A synthetic mount-info document for the volume identity guard's mounted_expected case. The volume_uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 is a fake (RFC 4122 variant bits set, version 4) used by the WP-C20 fixtures and the gate; it is never a real operator volume. The fs_type apfs is the macOS/APFS label diskutil would report. This file is a descriptor consumed by an injected provider in tests and CI; no real disk is probed.
